items.text: A new threat has arrived, a new area is waiting to be explored, and Version 1.1 also brings stability improvements, fixes, and expanded voice recognition localization.
Added a new monster — it starts completely motionless, then suddenly charges at you and explodes.
Added a new location — a snowy mountain area with parkour elements.
Further optimized the network side for better overall stability.
Added EN / DE / ES / FR / RU localizations for the voice recognition feature.
Fixed several bugs.
Fixed multiple localization issues.
Fixed several crash-related issues.
Fixed an issue where some achievements would not unlock properly.
Fixed mine drop issues.
Fixed a reconnect-related issue.
Thank you for playing Dreadway and for all the feedback. More updates are coming.

items.text: Security vulnerabilities
Various issues that caused lag
A freeze when recreating a game after voting to “Play Again”
A bug where players could load into the train with a black screen
A bug where players wouldn’t die after reconnecting
A bug where players under the Shrinking Potion could clip through train/bunker geometry and fall into the void, or exit the train while it was moving
Fixed some localization inaccuracies
Optimized netcode
When holding two-handed items, the “drop item” logic on G can break (rejoining fixes it)
Monsters can get stuck near the train
After playing for 20+ days and 3+ hours with unstable internet, the host’s train physics may break and players may be able to walk through its walls
If you jump with the Shrinking Potion right as the train stops, you may get thrown onto the tracks (can happen if you were in the air while the train was moving, or if the host lagged)
Sometimes opening a chest spawns no loot
Lever hints in the train can be out of sync between players
Weather preset sometimes doesn’t apply, causing the level to be too bright
The known issues list is not complete and is updated daily.
Thank you for helping us improve the game and for actively reporting problems in our Discord.
Over the past two weeks since release, we’ve done a lot of work fixing bugs.
Once we’re done with the major fixes, we’ll start expanding the content — adding more locations and more bunkers, as you requested.
Fixed lag for players 2 and 3 when the 4th player joined the session. 🧍‍♂️🧍‍♂️➕🧍‍♂️
Fixed an issue where some players received “Lost connection with host” when connecting to a host with server ping above 150 ms. 📶⚠️

After 4 days of effort, we managed to diagnose and fix a bug that caused severe lag for players using a VPN, players from Russia, or simply players with ping higher than 150 ms when a 3rd or 4th player joined a session. 🕵️‍♂️🔧🌍
Additionally, when connecting to a host whose ping to the server was higher than 150 ms, some players would get the error “Lost connection with host”. ❌🔌

We discovered that synchronizing all physical body parts of corpse ragdolls over the network was so expensive—and hit the host’s connection so hard when the 4th player joined—that it completely killed the host’s ability to send packets to all 3 clients. 💀🧩📦💥
✅ We have now optimized the network synchronization for corpses, and this issue is no longer present. 🚀
If you run into this problem again, please let us know on Discord and leave a report in our bug tracker:
bug tracker🧷🐞
We apologize to everyone who couldn’t play as a group of four at launch because of this bug! 🙏😓
But it’s fixed now—make sure to try playing this weekend! 🎮🍿🔥
Hover effect on the Quit Game button in the main menu ✨
Localization errors 🌍
Session names had too much text and were overlapping other UI elements
Various UI bugs
Improved text scaling for some localizations 🔠
Removed the microphone threshold setting — ~90% of players confused it with volume and couldn’t hear each other 🎙️
Region is displayed incorrectly when creating a session, which may cause connection problems 🌐
You can “fly” under the map using the shrinking potion 🧪
Outdoor monsters sometimes get stuck in the navmesh and stack in one spot 👾
If you hold the shrinking potion and pick up an item, the item becomes enlarged 📦
If you place the shotgun / flashlight / glow sticks into the workbench, they get recharged 🔋
One location has overly bright weather ☀️
On day 10+, players with poor connection may experience broken physics and fall through the train floor 🚆
V-Sync is currently enabled by default 🎮
That’s everything we’ve managed to gather from your reports and reproduce so far.
Please keep reporting bugs in our Discord — we’ll fix everything we can 🙏
Soon we’ll begin localizing voice phrase recognition for all supported languages 🗣️🌍
It was really hard to build this game for 2 years on pure enthusiasm and release it in an unfinished state — we’re truly sorry.
We’ll improve, and we’ll keep developing and polishing the game as promised in the Roadmap.
We finally found and fixed the issue that was causing disconnects, poor connection quality, and the host not showing up in the session list.

Please keep reporting any connection issues in our Discord. If anyone runs into a case where they can’t connect to a friend, create a ticket in Discord — I’ll jump in with you right away and we’ll try to track down the source of the problem together.
We’re sorry for the connection problems at launch — things should be much better now.
Fixed microphone issues where it would work poorly or cut out.
Fixed a bug where a player could leave the train while using the shrinking potion.
Fixed a bug where a mine wouldn’t trigger under a monster.
Fixed a crafting bug where you couldn’t craft due to “missing resources” even though you had enough.
When the 4th player joins, the lobby can sometimes break.
When players join a lobby, the host may get disconnected.
After changing region, some players need to restart the game to see the lobby list again.
Lobbies can disappear from the list.
We’re actively working to improve your experience and will do our best to fix the issues that are hurting gameplay as soon as possible. Huge thanks to everyone reporting bugs in our Discord!
🎓 New Tutorial added
🏥 New location: Abandoned Hospital Bunker
🎙️ Voice-driven mechanics: phrase recognition + codeword locks + enemies flee on correct callouts
🌍 Lobby overhaul: 12 global regions + smart region selection by ping
🔧 Tons of stability fixes (softlocks, desyncs, falling through the world, interaction bugs)
Added a Tutorial
Added a new location: Abandoned Hospital Bunker
Added breath vapor (visible breath)
Added ultrawide monitor support
Added adrenaline syringe to revive players
Added spawn/despawn notifications for outdoor monsters
Added nuclear strike warnings: 10 hours and 1 hour before impact
Added voice phrase recognition from voice chat
Added locked doors that open when you correctly pronounce codewords
Enemies now flee for 7 seconds if you say the correct codeword loudly and clearly towards them
Added a red VOIP indicator light that shines brighter based on voice chat activation/volume
Added a profanity filter for session names (during session creation)
Refactored the lobby into a session-based system
Added 12 worldwide regions + automatic best-region selection by ping
Fixed workbench UI desync after reconnects

notes.title: Added a workbench checkpoint to the middle of every bunker

items.text: Store loot safely and keep exploring
Craft inside the bunker
If a player is AFK inside the workbench, they’ll be kicked out after 15 seconds
Fixed cases where players could get stuck inside the workbench
Fixed cases where the workbench became unusable if someone entered it and then left the game
Fixed double-playing emote animations on clients
Fixed falling through the map (including in the train)
Fixed players clipping through train walls and/or falling onto the rails
Fixed items sticking to player models
Fixed cases where you couldn’t interact with items or player corpses
Fixed Tick behavior bugs + freezes after Tick attacks
Fixed first-person player animation issues
Fixed Lunchbox VFX display issues
Fixed items not staying on the train after leaving a location
Fixed a bug where items dropped on one map could carry over to another
Fixed cases where the player lost control of the character
Fixed a bug where Motion Blur and other settings didn’t save properly
Fixed campfire damage affecting players from too far away
Fixed multiple localization issues and some main menu fonts for certain languages
Fixed a bug where the train lever didn’t reset after cooldown
Fixed a bug where the train could start with <20% fuel if all players died
Fixed dozens of issues that could cause general game breakage / softlocks
Reduced player speed gained from the Speed upgrade
Reduced UI scroll sensitivity to a normal level
Reduced the number of mines and traps on locations (player feedback)
Reduced monster running speed by ~33% (1.5x slower)
Reduced time to explosion after throwing a grenade
More locations with a shorter route to the bunker (so less running)
Increased stamina and default player speed (player feedback)
Charged kick = 30 damage
Uncharged kick = 5 damage
Added more VFX to kicks
Added a burn zone in front of the furnace (yes—you can kick your friend into it 🔥)
Added swing SFX for Crowbar and Syringe
Added tile footstep sounds for the new Hospital bunker level
Removed summer ambience sounds from weather presets
Optimized fire VFX for low-end devices
Fixed the seizure/flashing warning resolution for sensitive players
Lowered bunker workbench interaction volume by 7x
Fixed excessive vertical mouse sensitivity
Reworked microphone detection/binding logic
Added a microphone sensitivity slider
Fixed Hamster behavior after trades: now returns to its stash, stores the item, and continues patrolling (no more “rocket launch” to the player)
Reduced Hamster trigger distance for transforming into a spider (happens less often)
Fixed Hamster ragdoll not enabling on death
Increased the distance for “begging” from the Hamster
Thanks everyone for the support — and especially for your bug reports. Huge shout-out to streamers too: seeing these bugs live on stream helps me track them down and fix them much faster.
Release is locked in for January 26. The game is currently v0.9.5, and basically the last stretch is just bugfixes and optimization.
In early January we’ll run a big closed playtest of the near-release build.

notes.title: Reminder: many bugs appear due to weak host hardware or bad connections, where clients lose packets or wait 3–4s for updates, missing game state changes.

items.text: We’ll keep optimizing the game & netcode so it can be played on weaker devices and slower internet.
We remind you that we are just three enthusiasts developing the game in our free time, aiming to make gamedev our profession and become independent.
So please wishlist the game, share it with friends and streamers.
Randomized eye variants for all player characters.
New encounter: “Toilet Monster.” Defeat it for loot-or get flushed.
UI now shows full descriptions for all artifact effects.
New artifact: Magnifier.
New artifact: Pocket Compass (teleports you directly to the train).

items.text: Extra traps
Monster density changes
More loot
Random fences/crates
Occasional nuclear blast events
Workbench can now perform level scans.
Restored in-game playtest feedback survey.
Monsters now react to sound - they can hear you.
Overhauled monster pursuit AI: If a monster loses sight of you, it now moves to your last known position, waits briefly, then resumes patrol.
Hit registration reworked for improved accuracy against monsters.
Starting fuel reduced to 20%. Each player now spawns with a gas can to compensate.
Spawns become fully random
Loot quantity, enemy count (0–20), and bunker size vary per run
Jumping is no longer tied to stamina. Jump freely.
Tutorial issues and incorrect prompts.
Inventory glitches and item pickup problems.
Monsters no longer walk on ceilings or get stuck in invisible walls.
Exit-door now always spawns correctly.
Crowbar now reliably breaks crates and barricades.
Fixed item pickup/drop animations not working for clients.
Adjusted item detection sound volume to correct levels.
